description: Header file defining classes, enums, and functions related to logic expression evaluation in firmware, including LEElement, LEElementPool, LECalculator, and related enums and constants.

classes.name: LEElement
classes.description: Represents an element in a logic expression, with an action and associated value.

classes.name: LEElementPool
classes.description: Manages a pool of LEElement objects for parsing expressions.

classes.name: LECalculator
classes.description: Performs calculation of logic expressions using a stack-based approach.

classes.name: LENameOrdinalPair
classes.description: Associates a name with an action, used for mapping names to actions.

methods.name: LEElement
methods.description: Constructor for LEElement.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the LEElement's data.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the LEElement with an action and optional value.

methods.name: LEElementPool
methods.description: Constructor for LEElementPool.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Returns the next available LEElement from the pool.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the pool to initial state.

methods.name: parseExpression
methods.description: Parses a string expression into LEElements.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the pool.

methods.name: LECalculator
methods.description: Constructor for LECalculator.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Calculates the value of an expression with a given selfValue.

methods.name: getValue2
methods.description: Calculates the value of an expression with a given selfValue and starting element.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds an LEElement to the calculator.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the calculator has no elements.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the calculator state.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Pushes an action and value onto the calculation stack.

methods.name: processElement
methods.description: Processes an LEElement during calculation.

methods.name: pop
methods.description: Pops a value from the stack based on an action.

methods.name: LENameOrdinalPair
methods.description: Constructor for mapping a name to an action.

methods.name: getNextToken
methods.description: Extracts the first token from a line into a buffer.

methods.name: isNumeric
methods.description: Checks if a line represents a numeric value.

methods.name: parseAction
methods.description: Parses a line into an action enum.

methods.name: float2bool
methods.description: Converts a float to a boolean.
